title: modern breaking animation
description: Smooth and improved block breaking animation for a cleaner Minecraft feel.
body:
Better Breaking Animation enhances the default block mining animation to make breaking blocks feel smoother, cleaner, and more visually polished. It keeps the vanilla style while improving the overall feel of gameplay.

Features:

Improved breaking animation visuals
Vanilla-friendly design
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Works well with most texture packs
No gameplay changes, visuals only

Important:

Visual enhancement only
Compatible with most packs and shaders
Designed to keep Minecraft’s original feel
